biggest_catch: Your friend must open a new 1st Advantage personal or business checking account within 90 days of the referral email/text, keep it open and in good standing for 60+ days, sign up for eStatements, have recurring direct deposit, AND spend $200+ on the debit card within 60 days - and reward delivery takes another 4-6 weeks after all conditions are met.
catches: Referrer must register at 1stadvantage.royalreferralcenter.com and submit a valid email address and phone number for both referrer and each referred person.
Referred person must NOT already have a 1st Advantage checking account; must open a new personal or business checking account within 90 days of receiving the referral email/text.
New account must stay open and in good standing for at least 60 days.
Within 60 days of account opening the friend must: sign up for eStatements, have a recurring direct deposit (payroll or government benefit), and spend $200+ with the 1st Advantage Debit Mastercard.
Friend must provide the same email address at account opening that was entered in the Referral Center.
Reward processing/delivery takes an additional 4-6 weeks after all conditions are met; direct deposited to the referrer.
Cap: up to 10 direct deposits in increments of $75 ($750) per calendar year; only the first referrer entered for a given person earns the bonus.
May not be combined with other offers; offer may end or change without notice.
Separately: referrer earns a $5 Starbucks gift card per 10 referrals made (max 5/year) - minor extra not counted in payout.

steps: Register for the program at 1stadvantage.royalreferralcenter.com and submit a valid email and phone number for yourself and each person you refer.
Friend opens a new 1st Advantage personal or business checking account within 90 days of the referral email/text, using the same email address entered in the Referral Center.

Friend keeps the account open and in good standing for 60+ days and within 60 days of opening: signs up for eStatements, has recurring direct deposit, and spends $200+ with the 1st Advantage Debit Mastercard.
Your $75 cash bonus is direct deposited 4-6 weeks after all conditions are met.
timing: Reward processing/delivery takes 4-6 weeks after all conditions are met; direct deposited to the referrer's account.
when_cash_arrives: Reward processing/delivery takes 4-6 weeks after all conditions are met; direct deposited to the referrer's account. The payout clock starts when your friend finishes qualifying, and the reward arrives as a mailed (or emailed) Reward Card 4-6 weeks later.
maximize: Start the clock ASAP: the 4-6-week card window only begins after your friend completes every requirement - have them qualify in the first days of the window, not the last.
Front-load the friend's activity (debit transactions, direct deposit) so verification does not push delivery past 6 weeks.
Watch for a redemption email - some ReferLive programs issue virtual cards faster than physical mail.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: payout is a Reward Card with a 4-6-week delivery window baked into the terms - qualification speed is the only lever.
